Performance Specifications#

Performance Specifications are explained in the Specifications <../usage/problem_formulation/specs> page.

bisection iterations)?

Linear Convergence#

If \(\rho< 1\), then all other performance quantities are \(\rho\)-weighted as well.

class spec.spec_stability#

Bases: spec.spec_interface

SPEC_STABLE enforce linear convergence/exponential stability of the algorithmic interconnection

Quadratic Performance#

The general quadratic specification

class spec.spec_quad#

Bases: spec.spec_interface

SPEC_QUAD quadratic performance \(\sum_{i=0}^T \begin{pmatrix} w_k \\ z_k \end{pmatrix}^\top \begin{pmatrix} Q & S \\ S^\top & T^\top U^{-1} T \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} w_k \\ z_k \end{pmatrix} \leq -\sum_{i=0}^T \epsilon ||w_k||_2^2\)
